description_en: The chest CT non-contrast screening result report generation capability is deeply integrated with the screening system, enabling the conversion of quantitative screening data into structured图文 reports and providing healthcare institutions with an end-to-end "imaging analysis–report output" solution
description_zh: 胸部CT平扫筛查结果报告生成能力与筛查系统深度协同，可将筛查量化数据转化为结构化图文报告，为医疗机构提供「影像分析-报告输出」全流程解决方案
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess generate-report --report-configs Action=CalcBMD Format=pdf TemplateVersion=1 Theme=dark --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateReport

element_fields.help_en:
Disease category name.  
Valid values:  
**CalcBMD** – osteoporosis screening,  
**MuscleFat** – muscle-fat analysis,  
**DetectLiverSteatosis** – fatty liver screening,  
**PredictCVD** – cardiovascular adverse event risk assessment
element_fields.help_zh:
病种名称。
取值：
**CalcBMD** - 骨质疏松筛查,
**MuscleFat** -肌肉脂肪分析,
**DetectLiverSteatosis**-脂肪肝筛查,
**PredictCVD**-心血管不良事件风险评估
element_fields.name: action

element_fields.help_en: Optional. Default value: pdf. Only pdf format is currently supported
element_fields.help_zh: 可选，默认值pdf，当前仅支持pdf格式
element_fields.name: format

element_fields.help_en: Template Version number for the graphical report. Valid value: 1
element_fields.help_zh: 图文报告模板版本号。取值：1
element_fields.name: template_version

element_fields.help_en: Subject of the graphical report. Valid values: dark – dark theme, light – light theme
element_fields.help_zh: 图文报告主题。取值：dark - 深色主题 light - 浅色主题
element_fields.name: theme
